relationship_description: Abdusakur Tan is the father of Abdusakur Tan II, both of whom have served as Governor of Sulu.
Abdusakur Tan is the father of Samier Tan, who is Mayor of Maimbung, Sulu.
Abdusakur Tan is the father of Shernee Abubakar Tan, Kusug-Tausug party-list representative.
Abdusakur Tan is married to Nurunisah Abubakar-Tan, Vice Governor of Sulu.
